name: Eddie Navarro
equipment: Heavy overcoat, navy, regulation cut, over a brown suit
.38 revolver, department issue, 6 rounds loaded, on his hip
Pump shotgun, 5 shells loaded, in the trunk of the unmarked Ford he is not supposed to take home
Nightstick, on the car's front seat
LAPD detective's shield, Hollywood Division, No. 1182
Notebook with every case he has ever worked, in order
Rosary his mother gave him when he shipped out, in his left inside pocket, always
features: Seen Worse (Ex-Service origin: +2 Constitution, +1 Strength. Advantage on saves against being frightened or Shaken; the first time each combat he is hit by a firearm, he keeps his reaction and any readied action)

The Badge (lawful authority inside the city limits: enter a crime scene, demand identification, commandeer a phone or car in an emergency, detain for questioning; advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion against anyone who respects the law. The chain of command runs through Lt. Dolan: unsanctioned use raises Heat by 1, and people who won't talk to cops give him disadvantage on Streetwise)
Academy Training: Riot Squad (+1 AC while wearing medium armor, not counted in his overcoat AC; he can shove a creature as a bonus action when he takes the Attack action)
Collar (when he hits a creature with a melee attack, he can use a bonus action to grapple it; he can handcuff a grappled creature as an action with no check)

Old Outfit (Veteran background: veterans' halls, legion posts and any bar with a flag over the register give him a meal, a bed, a lead or a quiet word; he can find a former Marine in most cities with a few calls)

personality.traits: I am polite to everybody, including the men I arrest. I write everything down. I go to Mass on Sunday at Our Lady Queen of Angels and I sit at the back.
personality.ideals: The law is supposed to be the same on both sides of the river. Somebody has to act like it is.
personality.bonds: My mother and my three sisters in Boyle Heights, who think I'm a good cop. I'd like them to be right.
personality.flaws: I trust the badge more than I should. Even after Dolan. Even now.

appearance: Twenty-eight, square, compact, with a Marine's haircut grown out an inch, a broken nose set straight by a Navy corpsman, and very steady dark eyes. Brown suit, navy overcoat, shined shoes. He stands like he's waiting for someone to tell him to stand at ease.
backstory: Eduardo 'Eddie' Navarro grew up on Breed Street in Boyle Heights, the only son of a streetcar mechanic, enlisted in the Marines the week after Pearl Harbor and came home from Okinawa with a Purple Heart, a limp that went away and a silence that didn't. He joined the LAPD in 1946 and made detective in a year because he closes cases. His lieutenant is Frank Dolan, who 'loaned' him to Harlan Shay's job off the books, saying the studio is a friend of the department and he should go where he is told. Eddie knows things about Dolan he has never said. In 1946 he saw Dolan take an envelope from a man in a studio car in the station parking lot, and he has watched Dolan close three cases too fast since. And he is the one person in the party who can read the Hollywood Division desk log without asking anybody.
